prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game inventory resource for SOOPKETMON, a premium Korean sci-fi fantasy game. One single complete MINING DRILL MACHINE isolated on a genuinely transparent background (RGBA PNG), square composition, 1024x1024. Sophisticated polished 2D game item illustration with high-end hand-painted hard-surface materials, crisp silhouette and soft volumetric shading, restrained luminous accents. NOT a photo, not a flat icon, not a cartoon toy. View from a consistent slightly elevated front-left 3/4 angle; the large spiral auger bit points diagonally toward the lower LEFT, the substantial motor body sits toward the upper RIGHT. Entire machine visible with 12% transparent padding all around. A compact self-supported mining power-tool machine: two short stable support skids, clear rear motor assembly, thick straight coaxial steel shaft and a broad realistic helical spiral drill bit, recognizably a drill and not a gun. The auger, chuck and motor shaft share one straight rigid axis without bends. Clean economical engineering, a small carry handle. No people, no hands, no lettering, no numbers, no watermark, no background plate, no pedestal, no cast shadow outside the machine. Gold five-pointed stars are the game's mined resource; do not draw loose ore around this item. This image belongs to a three-drill series with consistent angle, scale and rendering quality. This is the ELECTRIC DRILL, the practical standard machine: matte graphite steel casing, cobalt blue enamel cover, brushed silver auger with carefully defined cutting edges, compact rectangular battery pack at rear, one restrained cyan status light, thick protective black rubber grip. Industrial, robust, capable, clean, appealing and convincingly engineered. No solar panel and no gold luxury plating.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production BACKGROUND PLATE for the Korean sci-fi fantasy game SOOPKETMON, the Master Star Mine. Landscape 16:9 composition, preferably 2048x1152. A vast majestic underground excavation cavern in charcoal navy and deep midnight slate, rough dark crystalline rock strata threaded with warm champagne-gold glowing seams and unmistakable naturally embedded radiant FIVE-POINTED GOLD STAR CRYSTALS. The stars are mineral bodies emerging from ore veins, not painted stickers. A few large star crystals frame the upper right and distant back wall. A sturdy industrial mining work platform with steel rails and a few restrained support arches or mine beams; cavern depth and a distant tunnel illuminated by thin warm work lamps. Premium painterly semi-realistic Korean game environmental illustration, believable hard-surface structures and rock textures, breathtaking but practical playable UI backdrop. Strong diagonal depth from a clear dark foreground work area toward glowing ore on the middle right. Leave the CENTER-LEFT foreground platform open and empty so the game can overlay a large drill cutout; leave quiet dark areas at the upper left and lower edge for real UI. The environment feels expensive, mysterious and calm enough for idle mining. Warm gold ore light against deep navy, a very small amount of cool cyan reflected work-light, tasteful mineral dust in air. No characters, no cars, no built-in drill machine, no monster, no loose coins, no purple crystal replacement for the stars, no text, no labels, no UI, no border or frame, no watermark. Do not place any bright bloom over the main empty staging area. Deliver one complete immersive mine background, not a website screenshot.
